主要内容: On February 15, 2019, Freshstart Venture Capital Corp., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Medallion Financial Corp., entered into amendments to the Loan Agreement and Note. The amendments extended the payment date under the Loan Agreement, effective January 25, 2017, and the Note, effective March 1, 2017. These amendments were made while additional negotiations for further amendments were ongoing. The amendments are attached as exhibits and incorporated by reference into the filing. The changes relate to the terms of the Loan Agreement and Note between FVC and the U.S. Small Business Administration. The amendments are significant for the company's financial obligations and its subsidiary's relationship with SBA. The impact is primarily on the company and the financial services industry.
